_threshold_comment: min_mc_usd raised from 50000 to 150000 by the user 2026-09-23: at $50k nearly every pump.fun graduation fired (~100/hr).
_comment: Thresholds for the launch watcher. A token alerts once when its market cap reaches min_mc_usd within max_age_hours of its first pool. The sanity filters drop bundled or fake-cap launches; set them to 0 to see everything.
_min_sell_ratio_comment: Honeypot filter: hold a coin whose 1h sells are under this fraction of its buys. In a 2026-09-23 sample, organic graduations ran 0.13-0.73; suspected honeypots ran ~0.03 (e.g. 3526 buys / 11 sells). A held coin can still alert later if sells pick up inside the window.

email_digest._comment: One email per batch of this many hits (muted ones included), sent via ~/flip-notifier/send-email.js to darup67@gmail.com. Added 2026-09-23 at the user's request.

alerts._comment: Desktop channels (popup, banner, sound) turned off by the user 2026-09-23; email digest only. Set any back to true to re-enable.

_ml_picks_email_comment: score.py emails model picks (P >= the gate train.py set on validation, passing the watcher's filters), each coin at most once per 2h. There is no gate, and so no email, if validation found none.
_jev_in_digest_comment: Adds Jev's read (impersonation, concept, scam language) under each coin in the digest email. Turned on by the user 2026-09-24. Alerts and picks are unchanged.
_emails_paused: All emails paused by the user 2026-09-24 11:4x. Set email_digest.enabled, coinbase_listing_email, ml_picks_email back to true to resume.
_plus50_comment: 2026-09-28: the detector shows only coins with a good chance of +50% one hour after being added (plus50.py; a coin shows only if held-out coins with that score hit +50% at least 40% of the time). plus50_email sends each pick once. Turned ON by the user 2026-09-28 (the other emails stay paused).
_pump_watch_comment: 2026-09-29: the ORIGINAL watcher (agent.py: >= min_mc_usd within max_age_hours, same filters, Solana + Base) stays on with its original parameters; its tokens and hits are checked against the Coinbase/Robinhood address lists, and only listed ones are shown. The later ML add-ons (pre-graduation collector, plus50, trainers) are unloaded. `agent.py --pump` shows the raw watcher board.

listed._comment: Coinbase/Robinhood-listed token board (listed.py): A = fast and steady gain, B = holds it. Thresholds documented in listed.py.

radar._comment: Separate radar of unlisted heavy-volume Solana/Base tokens (not the watcher; the watcher keeps its original parameters).
